notes: B09-P1 remains the default baseline: residual and surplus are physical identities only.

B08 up/down flex remains physical capability only.
System-level storage may enter only through a separate explicit asset/SOC/schedule contract.
ENTSO-E A75/A16/A08/Bxx semantics already support Hungarian control-area generation grain. Regional mapping is not a national-baseline prerequisite.
National generation cannot be relabelled or spatially split into DSO/county generation.
Repository redistribution permission is separate from model-use authority.
DSO/county generation is no longer a prerequisite for a national control-area generation baseline.
Dispatch/storage authority is now explicit: baseline has no dispatch; optional system storage requires separate asset/SOC/schedule authority.
